pdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg}
    comps = []
    while cells:
        start = cells.pop()
        comp = {start}
        q = [start]
        while q:
            r, c = q.pop()
            for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
                for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                    p = (r + dr, c + dc)
                    if p in cells:
                        cells.remove(p)
                        comp.add(p)
                        q.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    pattern = max(comps, key=len)
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pattern)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in pattern)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in pattern)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in pattern)
    stamp = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    targets = [p for comp in comps if comp is not pattern for p in comp]
    # Each isolated non-background mark is the center of the copied pattern.
    cr, cc = (r1 - r0) // 2, (c1 - c0) // 2
    for r, c in targets:
        top, left = r - cr, c - cc
        for i in range(len(stamp)):
            for j in range(len(stamp[0])):
                rr, cc2 = top + i, left + j
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc2 < w:
                    out[rr][cc2] = stamp[i][j]
    return out
'''
